title: Shifted small bias density
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a nonzero natural number $\ell$, the shifted small bias generator density is the probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ obtained by pairing the shifted small bias field family with the field pairing construction.
caveat: The defining constructions `fieldPairingDensity` and `shiftedSmallBiasFieldFamily` are not supplied, so the construction can only be described by their names and relationship.
